title: Adventurous Pork Chops
description: A delicious and spicy dish that combines the flavors of adventurous seasoning with the sweetness of pineapple. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together adventurous seasoning, garlic, and pineapple juice.
Season pork chops with salt and black pepper.
Heat coconut oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer skillet to oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until pork chops reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
While pork chops are cooking, combine tart cranberries and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
After pork chops are done, let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve pork chops with cranberry mixture spooned over the top.
